description: T4-4 calibration case (docs/test-campaigns/phase-12.md): _cache_bounded's `except (StopIteration, RuntimeError)` guards a benign race between the connect path and the watch executor thread evicting the same cache concurrently. The named suite (tests/test_server_predicted_heat.py) never races these two paths — its bounding tests call _cache_bounded sequentially — so narrowing the catch to StopIteration alone is expected to survive it. (Campaign C4's concurrency tests do reach the handler: see agent-cache-bounded-race-guard-stalled and -hammered, both killed.) This is the harness's own self-test: it must report a true survivor as a survivor, not silently pass everything. Promoting this spec itself to 'killed' would mean adding such a test to that suite; C4 covered the handler in test_concurrency_parsers_caches.py instead.

target.find: except (StopIteration, RuntimeError):  # raced by the other thread
target.replace: except StopIteration:  # raced by the other thread
